name: ADP Global Payroll
summary: ADP Global Payroll runs payroll for companies with their own entities in 140+ countries and territories. It publishes no price, so cost comes from a quote requested through the vendor's pricing and demo forms.

facts.text: ADP's product page says the service scales from 1 employee to hundreds of thousands in 140+ countries and territories.
The page cites deep local regulatory and compliance expertise, and global security and compliance programs backed by 300+ security specialists.
ADP says customers can access consolidated, real-time payroll data across countries.
The page names no SOC or ISO certification and no specific integration partners, only a general statement about connecting to popular software, ERPs and HR systems.

hiddenCosts: No price is published. The page offers a Get Pricing link and a demo request only.
Contract length, setup fees and per-country charges are not stated on the page.
